title: Do Coding Agents Still Need a Debugger? Frontier-Model-Based Fault Localization at the Accuracy Ceiling
abstract: arXiv:2610.36015v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Background: To localize a fault, a coding agent can reason from source code alone or use debugger assistance by running the program and stepping through it in an interactive debugger. While earlier agents struggled with static execution tracing and debugger operation, frontier LLMs have improved at both. Objective: We evaluate how accurately coding agents localize faults without tools across original and transformed programs, how much debugger assistance improves accuracy and at what cost, and how agents use it when optional. Methods: We seed 610 single-line faults into 144 LeetCodeDataset solutions and rewrite each faulty program with five recipes of behavior-preserving transformations. Agents based on Sol 6.1, Luna 6, and Qwen 3.8 localize each fault with no, optional, or encouraged debugger assistance. translated_title: 编程智能体还需要调试器吗？基于前沿模型的故障定位逼近准确率上限
translated_abstract: 背景：为了定位故障，编程智能体可以仅凭源代码进行推理，也可以借助调试器，通过运行程序并在交互式调试器中单步执行来获得辅助。虽然早期的智能体在静态执行追踪和调试器操作方面表现不佳，但前沿大语言模型在这两方面均已显著提升。目标：我们评估编程智能体在不使用工具的情况下，在原始程序和变换后程序上定位故障的准确程度，调试器辅助能在多大程度上提升准确率以及代价是什么，以及当调试器可选时智能体如何使用它。方法：我们将610个单行故障注入144个LeetCodeDataset解答中，并用五种保持行为不变的变换配方重写每个故障程序。基于Sol 6.1、Luna 6和Qwen 3.8的智能体在无调试器辅助、可选调试器辅助或鼓励使用调试器辅助的条件下对每个故障进行定位。结果：在不使用工具的情况下，各智能体在原始程序中定位了98.2%至99.9%的故障，在变换后程序中定位了96.7%至99.9%的故障，损失了（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究通过在610个注入故障的大规模实验发现，基于前沿大模型的编程智能体仅凭源代码推理即可将故障定位准确率提升至98%以上的天花板水平，调试器的额外辅助收益已微乎其微。
en_tdlr: This study shows through large-scale experiments on 610 seeded faults that coding agents powered by frontier LLMs achieve near-ceiling fault localization accuracy (up to 99.9%) from source code alone, making debugger assistance largely unnecessary.
